summary.zh: 设计或修复推荐、联盟与大使计划，并测算奖励成本
summary.en: Design referral and affiliate programs and model rewards against ROI

description.zh: 从奖励规则、触发时机、归因和防作弊到邀请文案，完整设计推荐、联盟或大使计划，并用计算脚本估算奖励成本与回报。适合新开推荐项目，或现有项目拉不动人、奖励发得过多时使用。计算脚本需要本地 Python 环境。
description.en: Plans referral, affiliate or ambassador programs end to end: rewards, triggers, anti-fraud and invite copy, with a payout model. Use it to launch one or fix a program that costs more than it brings. Needs local Python.
